information: ## Esta competição terá Dual Rounds. **Resultados em direto não estão no WCA Live, deve usar [Resultados em Direto](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026/live)** **Em caso de problemas técnicos, o formato de Dual Rounds não será utilizado.** Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#54123-informacao-importante-important-information), [Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#54122-perguntas-frequentes-faq) e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um desconto exclusivo de 20%, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54121-associados-aps-aps-associates). ​ ## This competition will have Dual Rounds. **Live results won't appear on WCA Live, you should use [Live Results](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026/live)** **There is a possibility Dual Rounds won't be used, as this format is being tested and technical issues may appear.** If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68468-informacao-importante-important-information), the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68469-perguntas-frequentes-faq) and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an exclusive 20% discount, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68473-associados-aps-aps-associates). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYxNzgwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fdd5360e7d95bc04aebbd6aeb81732ac71a2d95e/1005165706.png)
